title: Add non-transferring show item to person action without gift closeness bump

sections.what: Add a non-transferring show <item> to <person> action so characters can display phone messages, photos, notes, badges, or objects without giving away ownership or triggering give_item's +5 gift closeness bonus.
sections.why: engine/items/transfer_actions.py (give_item, lines 95-120) is the only way to hand someone an object and always transfers possession plus adds +5 mutual closeness, while engine/items/examine_actions.py only surfaces observations to the acting viewer. Characters cannot show someone a text message, photograph, ID card, or item in hand without handing over the object itself.
sections.how: 1. Implement show_item(world, actor_name, item_name, target_name) sharing item readability/description extraction from examine_actions.py while keeping carry/equipped ownership untouched (never calling give_item's transfer or +5 closeness bump).\n2. Mark the shown item as examined/seen for target (and optionally reveal if it was concealed), fire relevant on_examine/reveal hooks, and deliver a structured perception/hearing entry + turn_event to the recipient.\n3. Register show in engine/action_registry.py, routes/action_handlers.py, PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, and contextual-actions.ts.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest verifying show_item preserves ownership, skips give_item's +5 closeness bump, and delivers item description/contents to the target character's perception.

acceptance.text: show (show <item> to <person>) is registered in engine/action_registry.py, PlanGrounding, routes/action_handlers.py, and contextual-actions.ts.

Showing an item retains possession/ownership on the actor, adds zero +5 gift closeness, reveals visible item details/readable text/media captures to the recipient (and same-area witnesses unless discreet), and records structured perception/turn events.
Covered by pytest verification for phone screen/note/weapon inspection without item transfer.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal item brackets (`show <item> to <person>`) and Event Stream turn log.

Current availability: engine/items/transfer_actions.py give_item (lines 95-120) always transfers possession and grants +5 mutual closeness; examine_actions.py inspects items for the actor alone.

Manual verification steps:
1. Carry a handwritten note, phone photo, or badge in the same area as Character B and run `show <item> to B`.
2. Check item carrier ownership, closeness value, and B's next turn memory/perception.
   - expected: Actor retains the item, closeness does not artificially jump +5, and B perceives the item's description/text.
